# Product Comparison Report

Compared products: Atlas, Birch, Cedar.

## Summary Table

| Product | Price | Project limit | Retention | Export |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Atlas | 120 USD | 40 projects | 7 days | CSV |
| Birch | 180 USD | 75 projects | 14 days | JSON |
| Cedar | 240 USD | 90 projects | 30 days | XML |

## Detailed Comparison

- **Atlas**: Price **120 USD**; project limit **40**; retention **7 days**; export **CSV**. [Source](http://127.0.0.1:59302/atlas)
- **Birch**: Price **180 USD**; project limit **75**; retention **14 days**; export **JSON**. [Source](http://127.0.0.1:59302/birch)
- **Cedar**: Price **240 USD**; project limit **90**; retention **30 days**; export **XML**. [Source](http://127.0.0.1:59302/cedar)

## Recommendation

**Best overall value: Birch.** It offers a much higher project limit and longer retention than Atlas, while costing less than Cedar. If you need the lowest price, choose Atlas. If you need the longest retention and highest project limit, choose Cedar.
